instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot. Indoors on a brown fabric sofa next to a window with green plants, the blonde woman in the black top and white pants (R1) sits facing right, extending her right arm forward. On the right, the woman with long curly dark hair in a checkered shirt and denim shorts (R2) sits facing left, raising her hand to point her index finger near her face while looking towards the blonde woman (R1). Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene with a neutral color palette.

R2 raises her hand and points her index finger near her own face
R2 looks toward R1 while gesturing
